_reproducibility_header: OH county murders/rates 2019-2025 v1. Per-agency FBI CDE homicide (HOM) monthly 'Offenses' counts, keyless /summarized/agency/{ori}/HOM?from=01-2019&to=12-2025 route for all 823 NIBRS-participating ORIs in the Ohio CDE agency directory (C:/Users/J/_ori_dir_oh.json snapshot of /agency/byStateAbbr/OH, 2026-11-23). Agency->county from the directory 'counties' field; 49 multi-county entries assigned to FIRST-listed county except Columbus PD (OHCOP0000) pinned to Franklin (city entirely within Franklin; CDE lists its jurisdiction counties alphabetically). Columbus PD per-year sums 90/179/212/136/147/118/85 (2019-2025); Cincinnati PD (OHCIP0000) 67/95/91/74/68/69/66 cross-checks the prior banked city-lane Cincinnati murders (67/96/93/77/71/74/69; 2019 delta-0, later years within normal CDE revision variance). MONTHS-PRESENT-GUARD: an agency-month is counted only when the CDE cell is numeric; ~30% of the 9,876 OH agency-month cells per year are null (small-agency reporting gaps), so the all-agency full-12 flag is rarely true. Two coverage layers banked: murders_all_agencies (every numeric agency-month summed) and murders_core_agencies_cityPlusSheriff (City + County agencies only; university/park/port/special-district excluded). 2025 = latest CDE summary vintage, subject to revision. Rates use Census PEP county estimates (PEP-vintage-2019 for 2019, vintage-2025 for 2020-2025).
